extDescription.message: Follow YouTube captions while browsing other tabs.

sourceHint.message: Select a video tab, enable floating subtitles, then switch to your work tab.

start.message: Enable floating subtitles from this tab

hint.message: Switch to another tab to see captions. Hover over the overlay to move or resize it. Browser internal pages are not supported.

idle.message: Open a YouTube video, then enable floating subtitles.

fallbackStatus.message: Reading displayed captions: $VALUE$. Enable CC on YouTube if no text appears.

connectionError.message: Cannot connect to the extension. Reload it from the extensions page and try again. ($VALUE$)

reloadError.message: Reload the extension from the extensions page. Details: $VALUE$

invalidSource.message: Open a video at www.youtube.com/watch and try again.

noSourcePermission.message: Cannot run on this YouTube tab. Allow the extension to access youtube.com in the extension settings and try again.

reloadSource.message: Refresh the YouTube tab after installing the extension and try again.

captionReadFailed.message: Could not read YouTube captions. Refresh the tab and try again.

videoChanging.message: The video is changing. Enable subtitles again after it finishes loading.

noCaptions.message: This video has no caption tracks.
